prompt_additions.banner_sheet: + Each banner is a full-width panel with its own background tone (ivory-to-champagne gradient or warm taupe), clearly distinct from the flat gutters so the three banners are easy to separate.
prompt_additions.icon_sheet: + Icons float on the flat background with no cast shadow or ground shadow beneath them.

gen.keying: light-on-light keyer (slice_icons_pl2.py + ovr2-platinum-1.json): object = ground distance > 6 (sheet ground noise < 3); the 1px near-white sharpening halo outside every edge is peeled; faint haze / sharpening specks are dropped; enclosed ground-coloured regions are kept opaque (pearl / silver / card-face highlights) except checked see-through gaps: gm-2 (1), gm-3 (2), gm-6 (1), gm-7 (1), gm-9 (1), gm-8 (2), gm-10 (1); edge alpha = projection onto the local foreground colour, edge colour = local foreground (no ground fringe); no tiles, no shadows in the sheet; bn-*-off = luminance mapped to grey 60..200

colorBinding: explicit fills (no variable mode); 11-colour strip with key-named swatches under the frame
figmaSlotNote: slot/<name> layers hold CROP fills of the two generate_image sheets (upload to Figma is blocked by the proxy, so the keyed transparent PNGs exist only in the repo); icon slots on light module backgrounds use DARKEN blend + image filter highlights +1 so the sheet background disappears; slots on primary backgrounds (active game-menu item) stay NORMAL; -off slots use a saturation -1 image filter
